text:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a mid-quarter change to Q3 launch scope. HelixPay (customer pilot) just confirmed they require Private KMS integration + FIPS for their pilot. Asking to move KMS support from our Q4 plan into Q3. This will push back some telemetry/analytics polish work. Thoughts?

Matt (Eng Lead): How big of a lift are we talking? rough estimate pls.

Raj (Infra Eng): Private KMS + FIPS on the private deployment path: roughly 3 sprints of focused work (2 infra-heavy, 2 eng), plus vendor compatibility testing and certs. Realistic ETA if we start now: 6–8 weeks.

Sophia (Sales): HelixPay starts pilot in ~8 weeks and this is a hard gating item for their pilot. They indicated committed capacity if we ship.

Anya (PM): Two options: A) Pull KMS into Q3 and defer telemetry dashboard polish (move dashboards to Q4). B) Keep scope and offer an interim workaround (customer-managed proxy). Which is cheaper/less risky?

Matt (Eng Lead): Interim proxy is a security no-go for enterprise customers. Not acceptable.

Raj (Infra Eng): +1 to Matt. Interim approach creates compliance exposure and ops burden. Not feasible for this customer.

Hannah (Finance): From a financial perspective, winning HelixPay could add ~$1.2M ARR over 12 months. Reprioritizing adds ~20% incremental infra spend for Q3 and a one-time contractor cost (~0.25 FTE equivalent). Net positive if pilot converts.

Sophia (Sales): :chart_with_upwards_trend: I'll confirm SOW language but likely we can get the commitment. I'll try to get signature window tightened.

Anya (PM): Sounds like we should reprioritize. For OKRs: proposal is to mark the 'observability polish' key result as a stretch (decrease scope) and move KMS work into the committed Q3 slate. Latency/perf KRs remain unchanged.

Matt (Eng Lead): Agree. Recommend creating a 'security sprint' and pausing the non-blocking perf optimizer tickets. Need a canary rollout + rollback plan for the KMS changes. I'll draft acceptance criteria and tickets today.

Anya (PM): Can we get explicit approvals? @Hannah approve the budget reforecast? @Raj confirm timeline and resource shuffle? If greenlit I'll update OKRs and loop in Legal for the pilot contract addendum.

Hannah (Finance): Approve high-level reforecast. Need the line-item breakdown in the reforecast doc to finalize. +1 here.

Raj (Infra Eng): Sanity-check: greenlighted. I can reassign 0.4 FTE from caching/optimizer work to KMS integration for the next two sprints.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created ticket INFRA-7712 for KMS integration and assigned to Raj.

Anya (PM): Thanks — I'll update the OKR doc: add note under KR-3: 'Move Private KMS to Q3 for HelixPay pilot — reduces dashboard polish to stretch. Reforecast +$150k Q3 spend; expected net positive ARR if pilot converts.' Will post the formal OKR update and attach the reforecast spreadsheet by EOD.

Sophia (Sales): I'll start prepping the pilot SOW addendum and ping Legal. If we can get the commitment within 2 weeks we should be safe.

Matt (Eng Lead): I'll drop the draft acceptance criteria into the ticket and tag the rollout engineer.

Anya (PM): OK — action items: Sophia to confirm SOW, Raj to update INFRA-7712 ETA, Matt to add acceptance criteria, Hannah to finalize reforecast numbers. Returning to channel once OKR doc is updated. :thumbsup:
